item.title: ドイツ、拡大する財政赤字の抑制必要 経済専門家評議会が報告書
item.description: [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済専門家評議会は１１日に発表した年次報告書で、政府が国防費と年金給付への...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ドイツ、拡大する財政赤字の抑制必要　経済専門家評議会が報告書 0:52 配信

2026年11月11日、ドイツ・ベルリンで経済専門家評議会がドイツ経済に関する新たな見通しを発表。REUTERS/Lisi Niesner（ロイター） [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - ドイツ経済専門家評議会は１１日に発表した年次報告書で、政府が国防費と年金給付への支出増加を抑制し、増加の一途をたどる財政赤字を食い止める必要があると警告した。

• 現在の予算予測ではカバーしていない２０４０年までに年間生産高の２．７─４．８％の財政赤字が発生すると予測。

• 評議会の提言には、補助金の全体的な削減も盛り込まれた。

• 報告書は、債務による軍事支出に関するルールは３１年から段階的に厳格化される必要があると付け加えた。

• また、輸出が増加する中、今年の経済成長率を１．３％、来年を１％とする、より楽観的な予測を示した。

• これは主要経済研究所の予測とおおむね一致しており、５月に発表された予測値（今年０．５％、２７年０．８％）から上方修正された。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：正念場のバングラ衣料産業　賃上げ圧力で競争力低下懸念、供給も混乱 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ コラム：安全資産性薄まる金　リスクオフでも買われず コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 11/12(木) 0:52 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: イタリア全土6300校に爆破予告、学生ら避難 英・アイルランドでも
item.description:
Alvise Armellini Giuseppe Fonte
[ローマ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alvise Armellini　Giuseppe Fonte

[ローマ １１日 ロイター] - イタリア全土で１１日、約６３００校の学校が爆破予告のメールを受け取り、直ちに閉鎖され、学生らが相次いで避難する騒ぎとなった。

スコットランド、北アイルランド、アイルランドでも、多くの学校が国外から同様の脅迫メールを受け取ったが、いたずらと判断され、授業に支障は出なかったとしている。

欧州では最近、スーパーマーケットや血液バンク、航空交通、放送局などを標的とした一連の脅迫やサイバー攻撃が発生している。

ロイターがイタリアで入手したメールには「ミソギニスタン州の指導者、ミハイル・アンドロポフ」と署名されていた。同じ人物を名乗る差出人は、６日にアイルランドとブルガリアの報道機関に送られた爆破予告メールについても犯行を主張していた。

また、メールにはメローニ首相を標的にするとの脅迫も含まれていた。首相は、爆破予告に実質的な危険はなく、警察や他の公的機関が状況を監視していると述べた。

＜ロシアとイランは関与否定＞

欧州の一部の当局者は、ウクライナを支援する欧州諸国の日常生活を混乱させる一連の工作の背後にロシアがいる可能性があるとみている。

ロシアはこれを否定し、西側が中傷キャンペーンを行っていると非難している。

イランの関与も疑われている。フランスは、先に多数のスーパーマーケットの冷蔵設備を機能停止させたサイバー攻撃をイランが行ったと非難し、駐仏イラン大使を呼んで抗議した。イランはこれらの非難を「根拠がなく敵対的だ」として退けた。

イタリアのクロゼット国防相は、メディアに対し、１１日の脅迫は「恐怖を広め、不安を生み出す」ための明確な戦略の一環だと表明。「常に外国や敵対的な組織の仕業とは限らない。注目を集めたがる者や、こうした時期に乗じて都市や地域に恐怖をばらまこうと待ち構えている異常者もいる」と語った。

item.title: 米中外相が電話会談、王氏「意思疎通・協力強化を」＝新華社
item.description: [北京 １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 １１日 ロイター] - 中国の王毅外相は１１日、ルビオ米国務長官と「前向きで建設的な」電話会談を行った。中国の国営新華社が報じた。中国側は米政府との意思疎通と協力を強化する意向を表明した。

報道によると、王氏は米中関係が現在の安定基調に至るまでの道のりは容易ではなかったと指摘。「両大国がそれぞれの利益と共通の利益に基づいて下した合理的な選択だ」と述べた。

今回の会談は、中国の深センで開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議を約１週間後に控えて行われた。同会議では、習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領の会談が見込まれている。

item.title: ロシア・ウクライナ、大規模な捕虜交換で合意 領土では隔たり残る
item.description: [アブダビ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アブダビ １１日 ロイター] - アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の首都アブダビで行われたロシアとウクライナ、米国の協議は、２日間の日程を終え、捕虜交換などで一定の進展があった。ただ、仲介に当たった米国は、ロシアとウクライナの双方に信頼が欠如しており、領土などの問題で隔たりが残っていると述べた。

ロシアとウクライナにとって９カ月ぶりとなる今回の和平協議で、両国は大規模な捕虜交換で合意した。しかし、具体的な発表はほかにほとんどなかった。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏は、戦争終結に向けて、仲介者が双方の利益に訴えかけていると説明。和平への道筋を見いだせると確信していると述べた。

クシュナー氏は「現実として、今は双方の間に信頼がない。このような紛争の後ではそれも予想されることだ」と述べた上で、協議では領土問題にも触れたが、これらが解決に最も困難な問題になるとの見方を示した。

さらに「妥協点を見いだせる分野もあれば、さらに議論が必要な分野もある。だが、これは非常に良い一歩だったと思う」と語った。

一方、ウクライナ和平協議でロシアの首席交渉担当者を務めるウラジーミル・メジンスキー氏は１１日、アブダビでの２日間の協議を経て、和平合意に近づいたとの見方を示した。

ロシア国営テレビの記者から和平合意に近づいたかと問われ、「そう思う」と回答。「ただ、現時点では、協議に関わる全ての当事者に大きく左右される。ウクライナや米国の姿勢、そして欧州が正気を取り戻すかどうかに大きくかかっている」と述べた。

クシュナー氏とトランプ米政権のウィットコフ中東担当特使は１２日にモスクワを訪れてプーチン氏と会談し、協議を欧州のパートナーにも広げる問題を提起する。同氏は、欧州のパートナーも交渉の場に加わる必要があると述べた。クシュナー氏は、欧州の安全保障の枠組みが合意の基礎になり得るとしたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

クシュナー、ウィットコフ両氏は１２日のモスクワでの会談後、アイルランドを訪問中のウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領と協議する予定。

LONDON, Nov 11 : AI chip startup Fractile was valued at $7 billion in its latest fundraising round, which included backing from the British government, a person involved in the deal said on Wednesday, making it one of Britain's most valuable technology startups. The London- and Bristol-based company is developing chips designed to improve AI inference, the process through which AI models generate responses. Fractile says its technology can deliver faster performance while cutting energy use and costs. The company raised $720 million in a Series C funding round led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint, it told Reuters. Other investors included Google's venture arm CapitalG, BlackRock, DST Global, Elad Gil, Balderton, SV Angel, Britain's Sovereign AI fund and the British Business Bank.

BRITAIN'S AI AMBITIONS The investment marks a major vote of confidence in Britain's efforts to build domestic AI infrastructure, rather than solely relying on overseas suppliers for the computing power that underpins the technology. It also highlights growing investor interest in companies developing the hardware behind AI, a market dominated by Nvidia and a handful of Asian semiconductor manufacturers. Britain has made becoming an AI superpower a key part of its economic strategy, seeking to build on strengths in AI research and chip design while retaining more of the jobs, investment and economic value generated by the technology. "For too long, Britain has produced some of the world's best scientific ideas, only to see too much of the technology, industry and wealth they create built elsewhere," AI Minister Kanishka Narayan said in a statement on the funding round. "We are determined to change that." Britain is home to chip designer Arm, whose technology is used in billions of devices worldwide, but its semiconductor manufacturing industry remains small compared with those in the US and Asia. Fractile plans to launch its first commercial chip next year. ($1 = 0.7492 pounds)

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 11 : Poland will not issue visas to Russian ski jumpers for its World Cup meetings this season, even if they were cleared to compete as neutrals by the International Ski and Snowboard Federation (FIS), the foreign ministry confirmed to Reuters. The ministry said on Wednesday that Polish rules restrict entry by Russian citizens at the country's section of the European Union's external border and at Polish air and sea crossings. Taking part in a sporting event is not among the exemptions. The ministry, which also outlined its position to Polish media, said there were "no grounds for issuing visas to Russian ski jumpers for the purpose of participating in sporting competitions within the territory of Poland". Wisla hosts men's and women's events from December 4 to 6. The men's circuit returns to Poland in the Zakopane mountains from January 15 to 17.

The FIS allows Russian and Belarusian athletes to compete as neutrals in individual events this season. It told Reuters that host countries alone set visa and entry rules. "FIS bears no responsibility for denial of visas or entry to any person granted eligibility under the FIS Individual Neutral Athlete Policy," the federation said. Danil Sadreev and Evgenii Klimov are among the Russian ski jumpers on the FIS list of approved neutral athletes, updated on Monday. The pair was part of the group that won silver in the mixed team event at the 2022 Beijing Olympics. Athletes from Russia and Belarus have faced restrictions across international sport since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. The International Olympic Committee on July 7 provisionally lifted its suspension of the Russian Olympic Committee and withdrew its recommended restrictions on Russian athletes and teams, with FIS having approved more Russian and Belarusian athletes to compete this season. Swedish Migration Minister Johan Forssell told Reuters last month his government was examining whether it could refuse visas to Russian and Belarusian athletes. Sweden hosts the Nordic World Ski Championships in Falun in February and March.

Source: Reuters

item.title: インドネシア副大統領が辞任、学歴巡る疑惑で 政情不安増幅も
item.description:
Ananda Teresia
[ジャカルタ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ananda Teresia

[ジャカルタ １１日 ロイター] - インドネシアのギブラン副大統領（３９）が辞任した。側近が１１日明らかにした。

ギブラン氏はジョコ前大統領の長男で、学歴に関する書類が選挙の要件を満たしていないとの最高裁判所判断が１０月に示されて以降、厳しい批判にさらされていた。同国でさらなる政情不安を招く恐れがある。

側近のブディ・アリエ・セティアディ氏はロイターに対し、ギブラン氏が１１日、プラボウォ大統領に辞表を提出したと述べた。

これとは別に、辞任の承認と後任の選定手続きを担う国会上院の関係者２人はロイターに対し、ギブラン氏が１２日朝に辞表を上院に提出すると語った。

ギブラン氏の事務所はコメントの要請にすぐには応じなかった。今回の問題は、ジョコウィの愛称で知られるウィドド氏とプラボウォ氏の対立が深まる中で表面化した。

FAST

LONDON, Nov 11 : Turkey needs to further strengthen its regulatory framework for crypto assets and stablecoins to address potential financial stability risks linked to the fast-growing sector, the G20's Financial Stability Board said on Wednesday. In a review of Turkey's implementation of international standards for crypto assets, the global financial watchdog said the country had made "meaningful progress" by putting much of the crypto market under regulatory oversight. But it said further action was needed to improve alignment with the FSB's global recommendations and address the risks of a largely retail investor-driven sector that saw nearly $200 billion worth of transactions last year, according to the review. It highlighted that cryptocurrencies and stablecoins have become increasingly important in Turkey for those seeking protection from years of sharp lira depreciation and high inflation.

The FSB recommended the establishment of dedicated regulations around stablecoins, which are typically pegged to the dollar and have been growing in popularity. "There remains no framework in place for the regulation of stablecoin issuers," the FSB said, describing it as "a core financial‑stability concern" given the strong FX‑linked channels and potential for "digital dollarisation".  SAFEGUARDS TO CURB CRYPTO, BROADER FINANCIAL SYSTEM LINKS The FSB's concerns add to a growing list of tasks for Turkey's authorities, who are scrambling to tighten regulations after a $20 billion investment fund scandal left millions of Turks out of pocket.Wednesday's crypto review noted the country had introduced safeguards aimed at limiting links between crypto assets and the broader financial system, including banning their use for domestic payments. But it urged authorities to also put in place a formal framework for monitoring financial stability risks, to collect and centralise more market data and improve cooperation with overseas regulators. "The borderless character of these markets means that no jurisdiction can address the associated risks through domestic action alone," the FSB said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Military-linked Chinese university bought Nvidia chips despite U.S. blacklist: Reuters exclusive
item.description: A Chinese university with deep ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a U.S. export blacklist, procurement records show, highlighting ...
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: BEIJING -- A Chinese university with deep ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought Nvidia’s powerful H200 AI chips last month despite being on a U.S. export blacklist, procurement records show, highlighting gaps in Washington’s efforts to curb China’s access to advanced technology. The findings come as Nvidia and its CEO Jensen Huang face mounting scrutiny in Washington over his lobbying for looser restrictions on sales of AI chips to China, following reports alleging he was targeted by a Chinese spying operation. Huang has argued that continued U.S. sales to China would preserve American technological leadership and keep Chinese customers reliant on U.S. technology. But some U.S. lawmakers say access to Nvidia’s most powerful AI chips can speed China’s development of AI systems for weapons design, intelligence analysis and military modernization. Both Democrats and Republicans in U.S. Congress have urged stronger controls on China’s access to advanced AI chips, such as chip-tracking requirements and greater congressional oversight of exports. Three Republican congressional committee chairmen have requested a briefing with Huang on Nov. 18 over his reported contacts with an alleged Chinese intelligence operative. Northwestern Polytechnical University bought two H200 chips last month for 874,700 yuan (US$123,000), according to an October 21 procurement record on its website. Northwestern is a member of the “Seven Sons of National Defense” group of Chinese universities under U.S. sanctions and with a history of conducting defence-related research for Beijing. The chips were purchased for its management school from Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology rather than directly from Nvidia, the record shows. The H200 is among Nvidia’s most capable chips for training and running advanced AI systems and is subject to U.S. export license approvals, which are normally denied for blacklisted institutions such as Northwestern Polytechnical. Northwestern Polytechnical also bought access this year to H200 chips and other powerful Nvidia AI processors through five contracts for rented computing capacity from Chinese companies, procurement records show. Reuters is reporting the chip purchases and computing contracts for the first time. Northwestern Polytechnical, Nvidia and the U.S. Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security, which oversees export controls, did not respond to requests for comment. Reuters could not determine contact details for Shaanxi Bosuan Network Technology. Trade blacklist Based in the northwestern city of Xian, Northwestern Polytechnical conducts research related to military aircraft, missiles and satellites. The U.S. Commerce Department added the university to its trade blacklist, known as the Entity List, in 2001 over its alleged involvement in missile-proliferation activities and military research. It tightened the restrictions in 2019, making licenses for exports of controlled U.S. technology to the university subject to a policy of denial in most circumstances. Northwestern Polytechnical’s purchases show how Chinese institutions with military ties continue to obtain U.S. AI computing power through domestic suppliers, either by buying chips outright or renting access to servers containing them. A Reuters review of 26 Chinese procurement and corporate records from this year found universities and research institutions buying U.S.-restricted Nvidia chips or renting access to Nvidia-powered computing services that use such chips through domestic suppliers. Several had close links to China’s defence industry or military research. The universities named in the records did not respond to requests for comment. Nvidia chips for military-linked research U.S. President Donald Trump’s administration began allowing some H200 exports to China on a case-by-case basis in January. But that policy did not lift the separate restrictions applying to Entity List organizations such as Northwestern Polytechnical. The January licensing rules also require safeguards to prevent blacklisted entities and military end-users from remotely accessing chips exported under the policy, which covers H200 processors and less advanced models. In addition to the management school’s outright purchase of the two H200 chips, procurement records show the university’s cybersecurity school awarded two seven-month contracts in January for access to servers containing eight H200 chips each. The contracts, worth 441,700 yuan and 441,000 yuan, covered fine-tuning AI models and reinforcement-learning training. It also rented access to servers containing eight Nvidia A100 chips and eight A800 chips. The A100 and A800 are banned from export to all Chinese entities, though the H200 is the most advanced of those cited in Northwestern Polytechnical’s procurement records. In April, another university institute bought computing services requiring at least 24 A100 chips in a 375,000 yuan contract for structural and fluid-dynamics simulations. The awards went to several little-known Chinese technology suppliers. The records offered scant information about where the processors originated or where the rented servers operated. Under Chinese law, public procurement agencies must verify that suppliers can fulfill orders before announcing winning bidders and signing contracts. A wider market The procurement records show a wider market for restricted Nvidia AI chips and computing services at Chinese universities. Shenzhen University bought three H100 processors, another high-end Nvidia AI chip banned by the U.S., for 769,800 yuan in September. Wuhan University of Technology bought a server containing an H100 chip for 355,000 yuan in June and four A100 chips in a separate 344,000 yuan purchase, the records show. Beihang University, another of the Seven Sons of National Defense universities, bought four A800 processors for 489,000 yuan in April. Beihang has close ties to China’s aerospace and defence industries and conducts research for military aviation and space programs. Two government procurement announcements in July and September named suppliers selected to provide computing services using Nvidia H800 and A800 chips restricted from export to China to the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences. One listed H800 access at 10 yuan per chip-hour. A separate January procurement award named a supplier of six A100 chips worth 484,800 yuan for a Shenzhen-based public institution. Reuters has previously reported that Chinese institutions acquired restricted Nvidia chips embedded in servers made by Super Micro Computer, Dell and Gigabyte through domestic resellers. Reuters has also documented an underground market in China for restricted Nvidia chips sourced from overseas inventories and third-country intermediaries. Last week, Reuters reported that small quantities of H200 chips had reached China through indirect routes while Beijing withheld approval for large-scale imports. (Reporting by Eduardo Baptista; Editing by Jamie Freed)

item.description: SAO PAULO, Nov 11 : Brazil's electoral authority fined Meta's Facebook 7.5 million reais ($1.34 million) for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during last month's presidential election runoff campaign, but said there was no evidence so far the company had deliberately acted to influence the outcome.

Brazil electoral court fines Meta, sees no deliberate election bias

Brazilian right-wing presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro of the Liberal Party (PL) and leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva of the Workers’ Party (PT), who is seeking reelection, attend a televised debate ahead of the presidential election runoff in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, October 23, 2026. FAST

SAO PAULO, Nov 11 : Brazil's electoral authority fined Meta's Facebook 7.5 million reais ($1.34 million) for failing to fully comply with judicial orders during last month's presidential election runoff campaign, but said there was no evidence so far the company had deliberately acted to influence the outcome. In a unanimous decision, the country's top electoral court (TSE) ruled on Tuesday that Facebook had failed to adequately meet court demands related to allegations that its platform treated content from the rival campaigns of leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro differently. Lula's coalition filed a complaint ahead of the vote alleging restrictions on the distribution of its posts, the activity of purportedly inauthentic accounts, failures in identifying AI-generated content and asymmetries in the operation of Meta's tools. Meta told the court last month it had adopted measures to ensure equal treatment of the two campaigns.

"Meta complies with Brazilian electoral law and applies the same rules to all candidates and parties. We will continue to present the facts and defend ourselves against false allegations in the ongoing legal proceedings," Meta said in a statement on Wednesday. The court said Meta had provided some information and documents on the measures, but found that parts of its orders were either not complied with, were only partially fulfilled, or were carried out after deadlines had passed. "The records contain technical failures acknowledged by Facebook itself, but there are no elements allowing us to conclude, on a preliminary basis, that there was deliberate action to unbalance the election," Justice Marco Aurelio Bellizze wrote in his ruling. "That conclusion would require robust evidence, to be produced through the appropriate legal proceedings," he added. According to Bellizze, the fine reflected Meta's conduct in responding to the court orders as a whole, including delays, incomplete information and difficulties in verifying some of the data submitted. The amount corresponds to three daily fines of 500,000 reais between October 17 and 19, and six days of fines of 1 million reais per day between October 20 and 25, when Lula unexpectedly secured re-election over Bolsonaro after his team mobilized a huge social media campaign. Lula has long vowed to tighten rules on social media in the country. In his victory speech, he said: "We had to overcome foreign interference in the election, coming from outside through digital platforms that we will have to regulate." ($1 = 5.5832 reais)

Source: Reuters

Nov 11 : CoreWeave jumped 10 per cent on Wednesday, igniting a rally in battered AI cloud stocks, as its hefty spending yielded strong revenue growth and the company signaled a pullback from the borrowing binge that had set off alarms of an AI bubble. The earnings also lifted shares of key CoreWeave backer Nvidia by 5 per cent, after a bruising two-day slide driven by worries about CEO Jensen Huang's future at the company following his affair with a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. Shares of so-called "neoclouds" including Nebius and Iren rallied after facing weeks of turmoil on fears that their debt-fueled data center expansion could backfire if AI demand slows. The Democratic midterm sweep last week dealt another blow to the industry, with several winning candidates campaigning for tighter regulation and moratoriums on new data center construction, including in the crucial market of Texas.

CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator told Reuters on Tuesday that greater scrutiny could slow data center construction across the industry, but he did not expect it to significantly alter the company's expansion plans or drive up costs. The company also raised its annual revenue forecast and said it would not tap unsecured debt markets after a recent spike in borrowing costs and that cash flow from existing contracts would cover both current and future debt repayments. "CoreWeave delivered about the best quarter we could have asked for. Stats were good-to-great, funding concerns were addressed and the strategic moves make sense," Bernstein analysts led by Madison Rezaei said in a client note. But they warned that CoreWeave "will be among the first and hardest hit" when the crunch in AI computing capacity eases. The risks of mistiming AI investments became evident on Tuesday as SoftBank took a $3.7 billion writedown on non-refundable payments for equipment to power its US data centers. That pushed the Japanese tech investor to a second-quarter net loss of $7 billion, its first in nearly two years. For now, CoreWeave's results gave investors in AI infrastructure stocks reason to cheer, with Nebius, Iren, Oracle and Applied Digital climbing between 4.7 per cent and 11.8 per cent in premarket trading. All the stocks but Nebius have lost 32 per cent to 48 per cent this year as of Tuesday, while Nebius has surged 60 per cent. Together, the cloud companies, including CoreWeave, were set to gain more than $25 billion in market value on the day, while Nvidia alone stood to add about $210 billion, if gains hold. Nebius is due to report results before Thursday's opening bell.

Source: Reuters

FAST

ROME: At least 300 schools in Italy were evacuated on Wednesday (Nov 11) after receiving a bomb alert message, the government said, the latest in a series of threats and cyberattacks on supermarkets, blood banks, air traffic and TV broadcasters across Europe. Italian Education Minister Giuseppe Valditara told La7 TV channel that the alerts were presumed to be hoaxes, adding that the number of schools affected was expected to rise. A large number of schools in Northern Ireland were also sent a threatening email, the Northern Ireland Education Authority said on Wednesday, but have been advised to stay open as the authority said police did not regard it as a credible threat. "Following a nationwide bomb alert, we wish to inform you that all students have been taken to a safe area and remain under the supervision of teaching staff," one school in Rome informed parents through a messaging app.

The email received in Italy was signed "Mikhail Andropov, leader of the Vilayat of Misoginistan," according to a copy of the message seen by Reuters. The same purported author claimed responsibility for email bomb threats sent on Friday to newsrooms in Ireland and Bulgaria. Italian Defence Minister Guido Crosetto said Wednesday's threats were "part of a strategy that is quite clear by now: to spread fear and create anxiety", according to Adnkronos news agency. "It is not always the work of foreign countries or hostile entities. There are also attention-seekers and lunatics who, at a time like this, cannot wait to unleash terror in a city or a region," he added. Italian police forces are investigating the matter, a spokesperson for Rome police said. France summoned Iran's ambassador on Tuesday after accusing Tehran of a cyberattack that disabled refrigerators in hundreds of supermarkets last week. Iran's foreign ministry rejected as "baseless and hostile" accusations that its Revolutionary Guards were behind the attacks. There are also concerns among European officials that hoax threats may be part of a campaign of "hybrid" disruptions, which many have blamed on Russia, aimed at countries helping Ukraine. Moscow has denied involvement.

item.title: 中国人民銀、景気下支え強化へ 内需拡大と供給最適化図る
item.description: [北京 １１日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は１１日公表した第３・四半期の金融政策執行報告で、国内外の逆...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国人民銀、景気下支え強化へ　内需拡大と供給最適化図る 11/11 20:40 配信

北京の中国人民銀行本部、2022年撮影 REUTERS/Tingshu Wang（ロイター） [北京 １１日 ロイター] - 中国人民銀行（中央銀行）は１１日公表した第３・四半期の金融政策執行報告で、国内外の逆風に対応し、カウンターシクリカルな政策調整を強化すると表明した。内需の拡大と供給の最適化を図り、年間の経済発展目標の達成を目指す。

・人民銀は、中国経済が強い供給と弱い需要のミスマッチ、構造的な不均衡、外部からの衝撃といった課題に直面していると指摘。対外環境は複雑さを増し、変動が激しくなっているとの認識を示した。

・安定した経済成長に向けて良好な金融環境を整えるため、適度に緩和的な金融政策を引き続き実施するとした。

・金融政策手段を適時に調整する方針も改めて示した。

・資金調達コスト全体を低水準に維持し、人民元相場を合理的で均衡の取れた水準で基本的に安定させるとした。

・報告によると、内需、科学技術革新、インフラ事業などの重点分野への金融支援を強化する。

・政策手段の拡充を図り、株式・債券・外国為替市場の安定的な運営を確保する方針も表明した。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：人民元に内外の圧力、海外は割安批判　国内は元高懸念 コラム：前途開けた中国人民銀行、「バズーカ砲」不要か コラム：人民元／円相場の記録的高騰に見る円の構造的脆弱性＝植野大作氏 焦点：人民元国際化に低金利の追い風、起債や融資が拡大 コラム：人民元高が堅調な中国輸出の妨げとならない理由 11/11(水) 20:43 最終更新 ロイター

item.description: Nov 11 : Once an underground combat sport, bare-knuckle boxing has followed the way into the mainstream paved by mixed martial arts, and professional fighters now find themselves with greater possibilities than ever before.Saturday's card at London's O2 Arena, promoted by BKB, will showcase some of the best B

FAST

Nov 11 : Once an underground combat sport, bare-knuckle boxing has followed the way into the mainstream paved by mixed martial arts, and professional fighters now find themselves with greater possibilities than ever before. Saturday's card at London's O2 Arena, promoted by BKB, will showcase some of the best British fighters in the sport, with Aaron McCallum one of those who will be wrapping his fists in thin gauze before his welterweight rematch with Simey Doherty.   "If you look at how fast it's grown now, I dare say in two years max it will just blow everything else out of the water," McCallum told Reuters. "It's going to be everywhere - the advertisements will be all over billboards, it'll be all over your normal adverts on TV channels. They're doing the (Anthony) Joshua (Tyson) Fury (boxing) fight now, advertising that, and I dare say that in two years, the big fights in BKB will be scattered everywhere."

CNA Games

Guess Word

Crack the word, one row at a time

Buzzword

Create words using the given letters

Mini Sudoku

Tiny puzzle, mighty brain teaser

Mini Crossword

Small grid, big challenge

Word Search

Spot as many words as you can

Show More

Show Less

The rise of the sport coincides with a time when some fans see traditional boxing fights as becoming boring, with an emphasis on defensive skills and footwork rather than knockout power leading to many high-profile bouts going the distance. "In gloved boxing, for me, every fight's the same now, it just goes on and on and on. With bare-knuckle, you do not know what's going to happen in any fight," McCallum said. BKB's style and rules are designed to leave nowhere to hide.  Consisting of a maximum of six three-minute rounds - or half as long as a top-level boxing match - BKB fights take place in a triangular ring that effectively keeps the fighters toe to toe for the entire bout.  CUTS INEVITABLE McCallum took up the sport when he retired from bodybuilding and said that the lack of padded gloves means that cuts are almost inevitable in bare-knuckle boxing, but that the risk of concussion is lower than in regular boxing.  "I've had a few injuries myself, I'm not going to lie, but I recover fast, and you don't really recover as quick in gloved boxing," the 40-year-old from Nottingham said.  McCallum's view is backed up by a presentation made to the California State Athletic Commission in March by doctor Louis Durkin, president of the Association of Ringside Physicians, as BKB sought a license to stage a test event in the state.  Meeting minutes show that Durkin told the commission that "while the laceration rate in bareknuckle boxing was much higher than in boxing or MMA, the concussion rate was much lower". Though BKB has staged shows at the O2 in the past, McCallum said that he has noticed a marked increase in interest of late. "I remember only six months ago telling people who just met me that I do bare-knuckle professionally, and they were like, 'You what?', but now when you say it, they know it, they know it's professional. It's just gotten quite big," he said. McCallum explained there are now young, hungry pro boxers switching to bare-knuckle early in their careers because of the opportunities it can offer, but he still has his sights set on winning a world title and cementing his legacy as one of the sport's pioneers.  "There's been a few fighters from Nottingham that's fought bare-knuckle on the scene, but nothing like what I'm doing now, so a lot of people have got a lot of respect for me and what I'm doing," said McCallum, who is on an undefeated run of four fights that include a draw in his previous meeting with Doherty in London in July. "My following's massive now... You just want to imagine where it is right now - I mean, it's going global."

Source: Reuters

item.title: イラン、濃縮核物質の国外搬出認めず＝安保トップ
item.description: [ドバイ １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ １１日 ロイター] - イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。

レバノンの親イラン系テレビ局アルマヤディーンに述べた。「米国が再び攻撃すれば、遠方の米軍基地も攻撃対象となる」と語った。

イランの高官２人は５月、兵器級に近い濃縮ウランを国外に搬出しないよう最高指導者が指示したと明らかにしている。

米国は両国間の戦争終結を目指すイランとの交渉では、初期段階から核問題を議題に含める必要があるとしている。レザイ氏は、イランと米国の間で現在、交渉は行われていないと述べている。

EU threatens significant fines for unfair online trade practices

FAST

BRUSSELS, Nov 11 : Companies resorting to unfair digital trade practices to push people to buy more or target children with personalised advertising risk fines of as much as 6 per cent of their annual global turnover under a new European Commission draft law. "Our consumer protection rules will help ensure that businesses compete on the merits of their products and services, not on their ability to exploit consumers or their ability to evade the rules," said EU justice chief Michael McGrath. "We are not making it harder to do business, we are making it harder to do business unfairly," McGrath told a press conference on Wednesday. The proposed Digital Fairness Act (DFA) aims to give consumers more rights but has been criticised by some businesses because of overlaps with existing laws and a proposed plan to keep children safe from online dangers.

The DFA, part of a crackdown requiring Big Tech and online platforms to do more to police their platforms, would need to be agreed with European Union countries and the European Parliament in the coming months before it can become law. The proposed law wants to ban dark patterns, which encourage people to spend more than they otherwise might, and gambling features such as pay-to-win and pay-to-progress that encourage overspending, especially among children. It would require companies to give users the option to turn off addictive designs of digital products and influencers to be more transparent about commercial content. It also takes aim at pricing practices such as dynamic pricing where ticket prices fluctuate based on real-time demand, which has triggered criticism from consumers, and subscription traps, which the Commission said cost consumers billions of euros yearly. A plan to revise separate legislation called the Consumer Protection Cooperation Regulation would empower the Commission to investigate big cases in several EU countries and also hand out fines up to 6 per cent of a company's global annual revenue. Lobbying group BusinessEurope criticised the draft law. "The Digital Fairness Act should make the existing framework more coherent, predictable and effective," BusinessEurope Director General Markus J. Beyrer said. "Instead, it risks introducing unnecessary obligations and overlapping requirements that undermine legal certainty and run counter to the EU’s simplification agenda," he said.

Source: Reuters

item.title: MotoGP chief defends Qatar GP decision but surprised by Yamaha withdrawal
item.description: Nov 11 : MotoGP's deputy CEO Carlos Ezpeleta said the championship was right to go ahead with the Qatar Grand Prix despite rider concerns about travelling to the Gulf during the war with Iran, but he added that Yamaha's withdrawal came as a surprise.Ezpeleta said MotoGP had based its decision on official info

FAST

Nov 11 : MotoGP's deputy CEO Carlos Ezpeleta said the championship was right to go ahead with the Qatar Grand Prix despite rider concerns about travelling to the Gulf during the war with Iran, but he added that Yamaha's withdrawal came as a surprise. Ezpeleta said MotoGP had based its decision on official information from the Qatari government and from embassies with a large presence in the paddock. The race was postponed from April to November 6-8 due to the conflict and Ezpeleta said they would have cancelled or postponed the event again if the situation had escalated. "We can unequivocally say that it was the right decision," Ezpeleta told Reuters. "Obviously, it was normal that the riders showed their concerns and I think that we mitigated those and confronted those to the best that we possibly could.

"It's just important in today's day and age to follow official information and real intelligence versus speculation on the media and disinformation, which I think ultimately was what brought a lot of noise around the event itself." Several Saudi Arabian sporting events - including soccer, tennis, golf and cycling - were cancelled or postponed in recent weeks after attacks on Riyadh's international airport last month killed at least 12 people. But Ezpeleta said Qatar had not been affected in the same way as its Gulf neighbours and that planning for the race had accelerated after conditions improved in the June to July period. YAMAHA WITHDRAWAL SURPRISED MOTOGP However, Yamaha withdrew from the Qatar Grand Prix citing "company-wide travel restrictions" for the Middle East, with the factory team and the satellite team Prima Pramac not lining up on the grid, reducing the field to 18 riders. "I can say that the decision surprised us, given the level of detail that was put into the assessment and all the planning," Ezpeleta said. "All the questions that Yamaha had were answered. Ultimately, Yamaha is a great partner of the championship historically and I'm sure they will continue to be. "We understand that it wasn't a decision that was taken easily from their side, but it is a decision that was surprising to us for sure." MOTOGP LEAVES SANCTIONS TO FIM MotoGP had said Yamaha's non-participation carried sporting implications, with any sporting consequences to be managed by FIM, the governing body of motorcycle racing. But Ezpeleta declined to speculate on penalties. "We just said that we would manage any contractual matters with Yamaha directly and any sporting conversations would be handled by FIM," he said. "We continue to say that it's a disappointment because I think one of the strengths of MotoGP as a championship is that all the riders, all the teams are committed for the full season. "I would say as a rights holder that the teams are committed and obliged to show up at all the events and all races." Yamaha and FIM did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. Yamaha's Moto2 team travelled to Qatar, with Izan Guevara in a close title fight and sitting second in the championship. He had a technical issue and did not finish. 'IMPROVE COMMUNICATION' The episode has also raised questions about how well MotoGP's management communicates with riders and Ezpeleta acknowledged the need to improve that relationship with all stakeholders. "We have to proactively push to improve communication, especially with the teams and the riders because they are obviously the most important part of the championship," he said. "We've been managing the sport for 35 years and we've had situations like this before," Ezpeleta added, pointing to the 2011 race in Japan held after the Fukushima nuclear disaster. "There was a lot of controversy at the time, as was now with Qatar, guided by misinformation and speculation, rather than facts," he said. "We continue to say that this was the right decision." Aprilia's Marco Bezzecchi won the Qatar Grand Prix but Ducati's sprint winner Marc Marquez finished second to establish a 60-point lead in the championship with two rounds left.

Source: Reuters

item.description: Nov 11 : An elite North Korean hacking group’s $6.3 billion theft from Binance is renewing scrutiny of a longstanding weakness in the cryptocurrency industry: hackers may need to compromise only one employee to get inside, while inconsistent security practices can allow them to turn that foothold into a massive th

Analysis:Binance hack reveals crypto's uphill battle against hackers

11 Nov 2026 07:06PM (Updated: 11 Nov 2026 08:03PM)

FAST

Nov 11 : An elite North Korean hacking group’s $6.3 billion theft from Binance is renewing scrutiny of a longstanding weakness in the cryptocurrency industry: hackers may need to compromise only one employee to get inside, while inconsistent security practices can allow them to turn that foothold into a massive theft. The October 29 heist, described by experts as the largest cryptocurrency theft ever, unfolded in a matter of minutes after months of planning and preparation, according to Binance’s initial investigation. Cybersecurity experts said the attack raises questions not only about how exchanges defend employees against sophisticated social engineering, but also about whether they have adequate internal controls to limit what an attacker can do once an employee’s computer or credentials are compromised. Social engineering is a well-understood threat in the industry, said Jonathan Alexander, chief technology officer of S&P Global’s OpenZeppelin, a blockchain security provider. The bigger question, he said, is why exchanges do not have stronger internal safeguards and circuit breakers to prevent an attacker who breaches an engineer’s computer — like what happened at Binance — from escalating access and moving assets.

Varying cybersecurity practices across the industry compound the problem, Alexander said, along with a longstanding aversion among some cryptocurrency advocates to controls they view as inconsistent with blockchain’s decentralized ethos that sometimes views things such as limits on transaction amounts and automatic reviews of patterns of spending as infringing on inherent privacy rights. "I think that falsely, that has led some people to think that things like circuit breakers, things like more controls on the accounts, would be unacceptable or would be absolutely in conflict with that need to avoid censorship," Alexander said. "In my view, you can have security controls and have protections against that." The Binance attack is the latest in a string of major cryptocurrency hacks that have resulted in more than $22.3 billion in stolen funds since 2021, according to blockchain intelligence firm Chainalysis. The scale of the losses has intensified debate over whether exchanges need more consistent standards governing access, transaction controls and other defenses. “I do expect we’ll see more clarity and standardization in the kind of cybersecurity expectations and, hopefully, requirements for investor protection and trust," Alexander said. “These things show why it has to change." HIGHLY VISIBLE, ATTRACTIVE TARGETS Cryptocurrency exchanges present unusually attractive targets because hackers can identify wallets holding enormous sums of readily transferable digital assets and, in some cases, the employees with access to the systems controlling them. That has made engineers and IT workers prime targets for elaborate social-engineering operations. Alex Pruden, CEO of blockchain and digital-asset security firm Project Eleven, said defenders face a fundamental disadvantage against attackers who need to succeed only once. “This is an extremely hard problem,” Pruden said. “The best practices in cybersecurity that we've had up to this point are just simply not up to the task of the world that we live in in terms of what the threat is.” Cybersecurity workers in the industry, he added, “live in a world of constant warfare. We are under constant attack.” Pruden expects the Binance theft to spur greater investment in cybersecurity, including safeguards around internal AI tools and agents that could themselves expand an attacker’s capabilities if compromised. "We're at the beginning of the beginning of that story, but I just think like the Binance hack showed, those tools can be turned against you very, very quickly and they can be very hard to undo the damage once it's done." Cryptocurrency exchanges have already begun moving to bolster defenses and increase information sharing following the Binance hack, Reuters reported October 30. PATCHWORK OVERSIGHT, UNEVEN DEFENSES The uneven security practices identified by experts are mirrored by a fragmented US regulatory system. Unlike banks, US cryptocurrency exchanges do not operate under a single federal cybersecurity regime. Instead, requirements vary depending on where companies operate and which state licenses they hold. New York imposes some of the industry's toughest requirements. The state's Department of Financial Services requires licensed companies to maintain cybersecurity programs, use multi-factor authentication and designate a chief information security officer. Elsewhere, crypto companies may be subject primarily to state money-transmitter rules. Those regimes generally require companies to provide regulators with information about their cybersecurity programs and undergo examinations, but often do not prescribe particular technical controls, such as encryption standards.   Many exchanges do not operate in the US and are not subject to those state oversight regimes, although they may operate under separate requirements wherever they do business. Banks, by contrast, are subject to federal requirements covering areas including risk assessments, monitoring and incident response, while the largest institutions undergo continuing examinations by dedicated supervisors.

Source: Reuters

Nov 11 : England batter Jacob Bethell will miss the white-ball tour of Australia after a setback in his recovery from a knee injury, the England and Wales Cricket Board said on Wednesday. • The 23-year-old has not played since England's one-day series win over India in July, having suffered discomfort in his knee while scoring 91 at Lord's. He had surgery in September and travelled to Australia in anticipation of a return, but a scan has ruled him out of the tour • "Jacob Bethell has been ruled out of the white-ball tour of Australia following a scan on his right knee," the ECB said. • England have called up James Coles and Eddie Jack to the ODI squad as replacements for Bethell and fast bowler Josh Tongue, who was already out with a left big toe injury • England begin the three-match ODI series on Friday before playing five Twenty20 internationals. item.title: ドイツ軍、中国製無人機の使用中止へ 安保上の懸念で
item.description: [ベルリン １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ベルリン １１日 ロイター] - 独国防省の報道官は１１日、ドイツ軍が中国製無人機（ドローン）の使用を取りやめると明らかにした。西側諸国の軍では、中国製ドローンが安全保障上のリスクとなり、機密情報が中国に送られる恐れがあるとの懸念が強まっている。

報道官によると、中国製ドローンはこれまで、費用対効果の高い選択肢として射撃などの訓練用に使用が認められていた。今後は欧州製品に置き換える。

報道官は電子メールの声明で「独連邦軍の自立性と技術主権を強化するため、中国製モデルは今後使用しない」と述べた。特定の国のシステムの使用を一律に禁止しているわけではないとし、今回の決定は軍の安全やＩＴとデータのセキュリティーを守るための個別のリスク評価に基づくと説明した。

また特定の国やメーカーの車両を一律に禁止しているわけではないと述べた。ただ最近の車両に搭載されたセンサーは潜在的な安全保障上のリスクと見なされており、必要に応じて機密性の高い軍事施設への立ち入りを制限することがあるとした。

item.title: 戦争・貿易紛争より温暖化対策を、各国首脳訴え 3日目のＣＯＰ３１
item.description:
Tuvan Gumrukcu Valerie Volcovici
[アンタルヤ （トルコ） １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Tuvan Gumrukcu　Valerie Volcovici

[アンタルヤ （トルコ）　１１日 ロイター] - ブラジルとトルコの首脳は１１日、トルコで開かれている第３１回国連気候変動枠組み条約締約国会議（ＣＯＰ３１）で演説し、戦争や貿易紛争で地球温暖化対策から世界の関心がそれることがあってはならないと訴えた。

会議は３日目を迎え、各国首脳による演説が始まった。気候変動対策の国際的な取り組みを前進させる新たな合意に向け、交渉の道筋を付ける狙いがある。

２０２５年の会議を主催したブラジルのルラ大統領は「１年前、世界はＣＯＰ３０を終えて活力を得た。しかし２６年初めにはこの勢いが衰えた。世界の指導者の演説や文書から気候変動が消えた」と指摘。「われわれは将来世代の生存よりも、武器や関税について多く語るようになった。地球が覇権争いに翻弄されてはならない」と表明した。

トルコのエルドアン大統領も同様の認識を示し、「戦争、危機、移民、飢餓、貧困によって、国際的な連帯の必要性は日々高まっている」と語った。

ＣＯＰ３１では約２００カ国の交渉担当者が、世界のエネルギー利用に占める電力の割合を高めるというトルコの提案への合意と、停滞している化石燃料からの脱却に向けた取り組みの再活性化を目指している。

国連のグテレス事務総長も１１日に演説、国際社会の気候変動への対応が遅れたことで世界は破滅への道を歩んでいると警告し、将来世代のために地球を守るべく、各国政府は一段と力を尽くさなければならないと訴えた。

排出量と世界の気温の上昇、気候変動に伴う災害の深刻化を挙げ、「気候危機の進行にわれわれの対応が追い付いていないという厳しい現実がある。これは相互確証破壊への道だ」と述べた。「しかし科学がわれわれに求めているのは降伏ではない。一段と力を尽くして闘うことだ」と強調した。

グテレス氏は各国にクリーンエネルギーへの移行を加速するよう求め、世界の化石燃料依存は気候だけでなく、経済にも打撃を与えていると述べた。イラン戦争開始以降、石油価格が急騰していることを念頭に置いた発言とみられる。

「世界の人々の４分の３は化石燃料の輸入国に暮らしている。自ら引き起こしたわけでも、制御できるわけでもない価格ショックに翻弄されている」と指摘した。「最近の紛争はこれが慢性的な不安定と生活費の危機的な高騰を招くことをはっきり示している」と述べた。

１１日は欧州連合（ＥＵ）のフォンデアライエン欧州委員長、中国の韓正国家副主席、マーシャル諸島のヒルダ・ハイネ大統領らが演説する予定だ。

米国は２年連続で会議への参加を見送った。フランス、ドイツ、日本、イタリア、カナダなども今年は首脳を派遣していない。

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国上昇、香港は下落
item.description: ［１１日 ロイター］ - 中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国上昇、香港は下落 11/11 19:37 配信

［１１日　ロイター］ - 中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場安定化策を市場は注視している。

上海総合指数は序盤の下げから切り返し０．５％高で引けた。ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．４％上昇。

ハイテク株が上げを主導。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は３．１％、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は２．８％それぞれ上昇した。

通信関連も上昇率の大きい業種の一つとなり、ＣＳＩ５Ｇ通信指数は６．７％高。光通信モジュールメーカーの中際旭創は１５％超急伸した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が１％安の２万４３１５．９２、ハンセンテック指数が１．４％安となった。

アジア域内の株式市場は、利上げ観測や原油市場動向にらみで動きづらく、狭いレンジでの取引となった。米国の消費者物価上昇率が予想を上回ったことや、政策当局者のタカ派姿勢を受け、利上げペースが加速するとの見方が強まった。

南華先物のアナリストはリポートで、これに伴う世界的な債券利回りの上昇とドル高が、中国Ａ株のバリュエーションを圧迫したと指摘。「足元の相場回復は主に、国内の市場支援策と海外の不確実性の一時的な緩和に支えられてきた。ただ、いずれの要因も効果の強さと持続性は限られるようだ。市場心理はやや改善したものの、投資家は総じて慎重姿勢を維持しており、株価指数は当面レンジ内で推移すると予想される」と述べた。

一方、原油価格は前営業日に２カ月ぶりの安値に下落した後、１１日は上昇した。イラン戦争の緊張緩和への期待と、ホルムズ海峡での船舶攻撃継続への懸念の間で市場は揺れ動いた。

Helsing enters market for battlefield software built on combat data

FILE PHOTO: A delegate walks past a display showing an autonomous uncrewed combat aerial vehicle by Helsing at the Berlin Security Conference, a congress on European Security and Defence in Berlin, Germany, November 3, 2026. REUTERS/Annegret Hilse/File Photo

FAST

BERLIN, Nov 11 : German defence technology company Helsing on Wednesday launched software designed to help militaries make sense of the flood of battlefield information generated by modern warfare, entering a market led by Palantir. Called Clarity, the software is designed to sift through information from drones, satellites, military reports and open-source intelligence, helping users identify military assets and determine how they should be engaged, Helsing said. Human operators remain responsible for approving any strike. The launch comes as militaries absorb lessons from Ukraine, where drones have transformed the amount of information available to commanders. The flood of data can overwhelm staff, increasing the risk of missed targets, delayed responses and misallocated resources if information is not processed quickly enough.

Ukraine has built systems such as DELTA to collect and distribute data, while Palantir's Maven helps military users analyse it. European governments increasingly want greater control over military software and the data behind it, while reducing their dependence on individual suppliers. But the most established systems have a head start. Palantir's Maven sits inside Pentagon and NATO workflows and has been refined through years of operational use. Helsing, which has supplied drones and other systems to Ukraine, is among a small group of European defence technology firms able to argue it has gained access to operational experience from the conflict.  The company said Clarity was built around hundreds of specialised agents trained on military data and that it could identify military positions, cross-check information from multiple sources, establish confidence levels and recommend responses while showing users the evidence underpinning its conclusions. "We are entering an era where success on the battlefield will depend on how effectively armed forces can transform information into action," Helsing co-CEO Gundbert Scherf said.  "It is therefore important to connect what is seen to what is struck." Helsing did not disclose whether Clarity was already being used by military customers or when it expected it to enter service.  Germany's armed forces have previously said they aim to begin introducing AI-enabled systems from next year.

(Editing by Milla Nissi-Prussak)

Source: Reuters

item.title: Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair
item.description: Nvidia customer Megaspeed has made global news with its former executive Alice Huang accused of spying for Beijing, but CNA’s checks found it has limited operational presence in Singapore.

item.content:encoded:

Nvidia faces deepening scrutiny over China chip ties, CEO affair

Nvidia customer Megaspeed has made global news with its former executive Alice Huang accused of spying for Beijing, but CNA’s checks found it has limited operational presence in Singapore.

Jensen Huang, president and CEO of Nvidia. (File photo: AP/Jeffrey McWhorter)

11 Nov 2026 06:17PM (Updated: 11 Nov 2026 07:37PM)

FAST

Nvidia shed about US$430 billion in market value over two sessions as new reports deepened questions about CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. The controversy escalated on several fronts on Tuesday (Nov 10) as allegations emerged that Huang's relationship with Alice Huang aided at least US$7.5 billion in Nvidia chip shipments to China and that US Secretary of State Marco Rubio had previously briefed President Donald Trump on the affair. Senate Democratic Leader Chuck Schumer demanded answers from the administration and tighter curbs on chip exports to China, while the company's independent directors hired outside counsel to investigate. Republican US Senator Kevin Cramer from the Senate Banking Committee called on Huang to step down as CEO.

"The potential for extortion is so tremendous that something as sensitive as Nvidia chips, I just think he's got to go," Cramer told Politico late on Tuesday. The allegations have turned Huang's personal conduct into a broader risk for Nvidia, raising questions about the company's governance and its dependence on the CEO who has led it for more than three decades and built it into the dominant supplier of AI chips. He owns about 3.6 per cent of the company — but does not have majority voting control — and runs an unusually flat organisation in which dozens of executives report directly to him. The FBI is separately examining whether 63-year-old Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. Huang has told employees he was unfaithful to his wife, but provided no details about the relationship. China's foreign ministry has said the spy accusations are "groundless." Huang apologised to top executives at a closed-door meeting on Monday before pivoting to business and was back holding meetings at Nvidia's headquarters on Tuesday, CNBC reported. Nvidia has said its board has no reason to believe US national security or company secrets were compromised and that Huang has committed to cooperating with the internal review. The board has retained Joon Kim, a Wachtell Lipton partner and former acting US Attorney for the Southern District of New York, whose practice includes internal investigations and white-collar defence, to lead the probe. Nvidia's stock, which had been nearly flat this year before news of the affair broke, has fallen 9.5 per cent since then. The shares have lagged the broader market on investor unease over whether massive spending on AI will deliver adequate returns.

Related:

Jensen Huang scandal could spur tighter US scrutiny of AI cloud providers in Southeast Asia: Analysts

CNA Explains: How honey traps work and why even the powerful fall for them

WHEN DID TRUMP KNOW? The New York Times reported on Tuesday that Rubio had briefed Trump aboard Air Force One en route to China in May about US intelligence indicating Huang was involved with a woman believed to be a Chinese spy. The briefing marked at least the second time in seven months that Trump had been told about the intelligence, the Times reported, citing people with knowledge of the matter. Trump said on Monday he had spoken with Huang and asked whether he knew the woman was a spy. Trump said Huang told him he had " absolutely no idea " and that he believed the Nvidia CEO. Trump also said he had not known about the alleged ties when Huang accompanied him to China in May. A White House official disputed the report and referred Reuters to Trump's comments on Monday. Schumer said on Tuesday that Congress must have a full accounting of Trump's defence of Huang and called on lawmakers to quickly approve new restrictions on US chip exports to China. "He's supposed to protect America, not China, not his friends," Schumer said, accusing Trump of failing to address foreign espionage in the American technology industry. US news publication Axios, citing sources, reported on Tuesday that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick was sent a highly classified memo warning about the Nvidia CEO's relationship with Alice Huang. Reuters could not immediately verify that report. The Commerce Department and Nvidia did not immediately respond to requests for comment outside regular business hours.

Related:

Commentary: Everything Jensen Huang said about China is out the window

Alice Huang, Chinese businesswoman tied to Nvidia CEO, went from finance to chips

WHO IS ALICE HUANG? Alice Huang , also known as Huang Le, along with her husband and sister, built a network of companies across China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, The Information reported. When orders for Nvidia chips subject to US export restrictions stalled, Alice Huang used ties to Nvidia to secure supplies, helping move about 240,000 H100, H200 and some A100 chips into China, according to the report. Some of the chips ultimately served Alibaba, Tencent and smaller Chinese AI labs. Reuters could not determine Alice Huang's whereabouts to seek comment. She held senior roles at a Shanghai investment firm before becoming the controlling shareholder of Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed International, which was linked to Century Litong, a China-based company that secured preferred cloud partner status with Nvidia in 2023, giving it priority access to the company's chips.

Closed doors amid high-profile scrutiny

Singapore-based cloud computing firm Megaspeed is in the spotlight following the United States’ allegations that its former executive Alice Huang is a spy for Beijing. Huang is also involved in an affair with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. At noon on Wednesday (Nov 11), CNA attempted to visit Megaspeed’s office at Ocean Financial Centre, but was stopped by the building’s staff. Megaspeed’s office is located on the seventh floor of the commercial building in Collyer Quay. The director of Megaspeed is identified as Tan Yong Pong, according to Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority (ACRA) filings. Megaspeed was incorporated in 2015 as 7Road International before changing its name to Megaspeed International in March 2023. Publicly available data also shows that Tan is also the director and sole shareholder of Swiftdata, the holding company that wholly owns Megaspeed. CNA also visited Swiftdata’s office at Block 26 Sin Ming Lane later in the afternoon, which appeared to be unoccupied. Ringing the doorbell at the fourth-floor unit at the Midview City business park brought no response. Workers from a neighbouring unit told CNA that Swiftdata’s office is usually shut.

Collapse Expand

Separately, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday that several US government agencies pushed for Megaspeed to be included on the entity list, a trade blacklist of groups connected to China that US officials say pose national security risks, but the US Commerce Department was delaying efforts to blacklist the company. The Commerce Department had sought more information about some companies under consideration, the FT reported. It was unclear whether Megaspeed was among those companies, but the delay has left it off the list, according to the report. The US Department of Commerce and Nvidia did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. Alibaba, Tencent, Megaspeed and Century Litong were not immediately available for comment outside regular business hours. Reuters could not independently verify the reports. Additional reporting by Fabian Koh.

Source: Reuters/rk

The country's flag carrier posted a half-yearly net profit of S$134 million (US$104.56 million) on Wednesday (Nov 11), down from S$239 million a year ago.

FAST

Singapore Airlines' interim net profit dropped less than expected on Wednesday (Nov 11), as record revenue from strong passenger and cargo demand helped cushion the impact of soaring jet fuel prices linked to the Middle East conflict. The company reported a 16.8 per cent rise in its half-year revenue to a record S$11.3 billion (US$8.82 billion), driven by record passenger volumes, higher airfares and robust cargo demand. However, a surge in jet fuel prices pushed fuel costs sharply higher, weighing on earnings despite improved performance from Air India and stronger second-quarter results. The country's flag carrier posted half-yearly net profit of S$134 million, down from S$239 million a year ago, beating a Visible Alpha consensus estimate of S$65.3 million.

The airline's expenditure rose more than 20 per cent to S$10.73 billion, largely due to a surge of over 90 per cent in fuel costs before hedging. Fuel costs remained a major drag on earnings, with average jet fuel prices surging 86.7 per cent from a year earlier amid the Middle East conflict, driving a sharp increase in operating expenses despite the airline's efforts to raise fares and cargo rates. "Earnings continue to reflect the weight of higher jet fuel costs that can't be fully passed through to customers," said Lorraine Tan, director of Equity Research, Asia at Morningstar. "This is anticipated and in line with the ongoing challenges for other international airlines." Jet fuel prices remain elevated relative to pre-conflict levels, and continue to place significant pressure on costs, Singapore Airlines said. "An extended conflict could also have spillover effects on broader macroeconomic conditions, potentially leading to further inflationary cost pressure and affecting demand for passenger travel and air freight," the airline added. It said that passenger demand remained healthy, supported by seasonal travel flows. Meanwhile, Singapore Airlines' share of losses from Air India in the interim period narrowed to S$361.7 million from S$429.5 million a year ago. It also announced an interim dividend of 2 Singapore cents a share and a special dividend of 5 Singapore cents per share.

FAST

STOCKHOLM, Nov 11 : Finland granted provisional approval on Wednesday for Tesla's Assisted Driving system (TAD) after the US automaker made changes to the technology, allowing its use on Finnish roads ahead of an EU-wide vote. Nearly a dozen countries, including Slovakia and Belgium, have granted provisional approvals for the technology, which allows vehicles to steer, accelerate and brake automatically under driver supervision. However, Tesla has yet to secure backing from any of the EU's largest member states, whose support is likely to be crucial to winning approval across the bloc. The technology needs support from a qualified majority of EU states. A rejection at EU level would invalidate national approvals already granted.

Finland's transport authority, Traficom, said it approved the system after Tesla renamed it from "Full Self-Driving" and tightened speed-control settings that critics said encouraged speeding. The regulator stressed its decision did not commit Finland to support the technology in the EU-wide vote, which it expects this winter. However, it said it wanted drivers to gain experience with the system before driving conditions worsen. "We wanted to go a little bit ahead to allow drivers to use the system on our roads before the really bad winter conditions arrive," Traficom's Jukka Juhola told Reuters. The next meeting at which an EU vote could take place is scheduled for December. Finland, which has 8,000-9,000 TAD-compatible Teslas, had signalled in June that it could approve the technology ahead of an EU-wide decision. "It represents around 0.3 per cent of the entire car fleet on roads in Finland, so that's actually one of the reasons why we feel we can move forward with this decision already because the number of cars is quite small," Juhola said.

item.description: BENGALURU, Nov 11 : India's government ordered internet providers to block 129 illegal betting websites this year based on two state high court orders that Reuters has found were fake, findings that have triggered at least one police investigation. The forgeries are the latest sign that fake orders are slipp

FAST

BENGALURU, Nov 11 : India's government ordered internet providers to block 129 illegal betting websites this year based on two state high court orders that Reuters has found were fake, findings that have triggered at least one police investigation.  The forgeries are the latest sign that fake orders are slipping past India's official content removal mechanism, considered one of the world's strictest, and could impact the online presence of any organisation operating in the country.  Court precedents generated using artificial intelligence have caused concerns among judges the world over. India's Supreme Court in July set aside a tribunal's orders that relied on non-existent judgments, and a US judge recently disqualified lawyers over use of fabricated legal citations.  India's Department of Telecommunications issued two website blocking directions on July 21 and September 2 - both available on its website as part of its routine uploads. Both directives came attached with emailed copies of purported court orders from the High Courts of western Rajasthan and northern Uttar Pradesh states ordering the removal of dozens of websites.

A Reuters review found neither court order appears in the courts' online registration records. After questions from the news agency, the Rajasthan High Court's registrar said in an email that the order bearing its name "appears to be fraudulent" and did not exist on its server. The court did not elaborate. In Uttar Pradesh, the Allahabad High Court found its order was fake and filed a police complaint on November 6, prompted by Reuters' findings, according to police case documents, which also showed an investigation against unknown persons has been initiated for alleged forgery and cheating. "It is fake. It is not a genuine order from High Court of Allahabad," Ghanshyam Yadav, a senior state cybercrime official told Reuters by telephone on Tuesday. He said no arrests had been made. Between them, the two orders affected 129 websites featuring gambling, which is illegal under Indian law. It was not clear how the fake orders were generated and if AI was used. The government's telecoms department, which issued the two takedown directives and sent the court orders to internet providers, did not respond to Reuters queries. Reuters could not ascertain who created the fake orders, which bore blue court seals with India's national emblem, typical of genuine court orders. Both remained on the ministry’s website as of Wednesday.  'SEAL OF THIS HON'BLE COURT'  Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government and police have often faced criticism for going too hard against dissent by ordering takedowns of online posts or websites. The government, however, maintains it orders such removals only in the public interest to ensure law and order. Elon Musk's X, which has in the past challenged the government's expanding blocking powers, last week itself got embroiled in fake orders issues. The platform told an Indian court that police directives it sent to two free speech groups warning them about removal of their accounts were found to be fake. In the case uncovered by Reuters, the telecoms department received an email at 8:59 p.m. (1529 GMT) on Sunday, July 19 containing what appeared to be a Rajasthan Court order, and was signed by "Aryan Chaudhary", described as an advocate-on-record.  A Reuters query to the email used by Chaudhary bounced back as "Recipient not found". The court order, now deemed fake, included an instruction to execute its directions within 24 hours and ended by saying it was issued "under my hand and the seal of this Hon'ble Court registrar". It was based on a powerful provision of Indian IT law that allows takedowns in the interest of national security. Two days later, the government told internet service providers to remove 34 betting websites "as specified in the court order as per the enclosed list," its published communication shows. 'NO SUCH ORDER PASSED BY HER LADYSHIP' The other fake court order issued under the name of Allahabad High Court, now under investigation following questions from Reuters, contained the court's logo and seal, and carried a QR code which typically allows anyone to verify its authenticity.  However, the enclosed QR code led to a random webpage that displayed a one-line case number: "Writ - A 30480/2026". That same number was cited by an individual who identified himself as advocate Kartikey Pandey and sent that fake Allahabad court order to Indian officials on August 22. A Reuters query to Pandey's email cited in the correspondence received no response. That email led to several back-and-forth exchanges among Indian officials, including one where an "action taken report" was sought, according to the published correspondence on the telecoms ministry's website. Then, on September 2, an Indian official told internet service providers to "take immediate necessary action in respect of blocking access" to 95 betting websites. Amid growing concerns of fake orders, India's Supreme Court justices last year said such fabrication "bearing forged signatures of Judges strikes at the very foundation of public trust" and "such grave criminal acts cannot be treated as ordinary or routine offences". The Allahabad High Court's fake August 14 order was signed under the name of "Justice Garima Prashad". The police case registration documents reviewed by Reuters say Prashad's office has confirmed that "no such order has been passed by Her Ladyship."

Source: Reuters

FAST

FRANKFURT, Nov 11 : Germany's antitrust authority, the Federal Cartel Office, said on Wednesday that a PayPal prohibition against online merchants charging customers extra fees to use the payment method may hinder competition and possibly violate the law. • PayPal, one of the most common ways to pay online in Germany, said that it does not share the office's preliminary finding but that it would "continue to engage constructively in the proceedings". • The cartel office, which opened an investigation in 2023, said that PayPal charges above-average fees compared with other payment methods and that its market share is also very high. • "As long as PayPal has to be offered without extra charge, consumers have fewer incentives for using another payment method, which would also reduce the competitive pressure on PayPal’s merchant fees," the cartel office said. • The office said that it was also considering whether PayPal may have to hand over profits it has gained through the practice and that PayPal now had the opportunity to comment on its preliminary findings.

Source: Reuters

item.title: アルファベット、初の香港・シンガポールドル債発行へ＝関係筋
item.description:
Scott Murdoch Yantoultra Ngui Roshan Thomas
[１１日 ロイター] - アル...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アルファベット、初の香港・シンガポールドル債発行へ＝関係筋 11/11 18:52 配信

グーグル支社に掲げられた同社のロゴ。2025年6月、ロンドンで撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Jasso（ロイター） Scott Murdoch　Yantoultra Ngui　Roshan Thomas

[１１日 ロイター] - アルファベットは初の香港ドル建てとシンガポールドル建ての社債発行で約３０億ドル相当の調達を目指している。関係者２人が明らかにした。

関係者の１人によると、アルファベットは最低発行額として、香港ドル建て社債で８０億香港ドル（１０億ドル）、シンガポールドル建て社債で１５億シンガポールドル（１２億ドル）を検討している。最終的な発行額や時期、条件は未定という。

起債は早ければ１２日の見込みで、ブックビルディング（需要積み上げ）と価格決定はアジアの取引時間中に行う見通し。決済は１９日を予定している。

ロイターが１１日に確認したタームシートによると、ＨＳＢＣとＪＰモルガンが共同グローバルコーディネーターを務める。格付けはムーディーズが「Ａａ２」、Ｓ＆Ｐが「ＡＡプラス」となる見込みだ。

香港ドル建て債の発行には中国銀行（香港）、中国工商銀行（アジア）、スタンダード・チャータードも参加する。シンガポールドル建て債はＤＢＳ、ＯＣＢＣ、ＵＯＢも手掛ける。

年限は香港ドル建て債が２年、５年、１０年、シンガポールドル建て債が２年、５年、１０年、３０年となる可能性がある。

item.title: 市場に細心の注意払い、安定的なマクロ環境確保を城内氏に指示＝首相
item.description:
Yoshifumi Takemoto
［東京 １１日 ロイター］ - 高市早苗首相は１１日の経済財政諮問会議で、城内実...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
市場に細心の注意払い、安定的なマクロ環境確保を城内氏に指示＝首相 11/11 18:45 配信

高市早苗首相。9月2日、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Yoshifumi Takemoto

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 高市早苗首相は１１日の経済財政諮問会議で、城内実経済財政担当相に、金融資本市場に細心の注意を払い安定的なマクロ環境の確保に向けて万全を期すよう指示した。政府・日銀共同声明に基づき物価の安定に向けて日銀と政府で連携する意向も強調した。

会見した城内担当相は、米ＡＩ（人工知能）関連株の調整の影響を問われ、実体経済と金融資本市場は企業・家計に影響しあうため相互作用を注視すると述べた。

経済財政諮問会議で民間議員らは、日銀が２％の物価目標に到達したと判断したことを踏まえ、物価上昇そのものを到達点とせず、賃金と物価の好循環の定着実現が重要と指摘した。会議の資料では、ＡＩ（人工知能）投資が鈍化した場合に金融資本市場の調整を通じて世界経済に波及するリスクなどにも触れた。

日銀は１０月２９─３０日の金融政策決定会合でとりまとめた「経済・物価情勢の展望（展望リポート）」で、基調的な物価上昇率が、安倍晋三政権発足直後の２０１３年以降掲げてきた２％目標と「おおむね整合的な水準になった」との認識を表明。一方、物価目標の「持続的・安定的な実現という観点から、２％程度の水準での定着度合いを確認していくことが重要」とも指摘したnL3N46G0BH。

これを受けて民間議員らは提言で「重要なことは、物価の上昇そのものを到達点とするのではなく、賃金と物価の好循環を定着させ、実質所得と生産性が持続的に高まる成長型経済を実現すること」と強調した。

提言では日本経済の現状と課題に関し「海外経済、エネルギー価格や金融資本市場の環境の変化、ＡＩ投資の動向など先行きにはさまざまなリスクが存在」するとし、「必要な場合には機動的に対応」してマクロ環境の安定を確保するべきとした。配布資料には、国際機関が、ＡＩ関連企業への投資集中や負債依存の高まりを背景に、ＡＩ投資や収益性の鈍化が金融資本市場の調整を通じて、経済成長に波及するリスクを指摘していると記載された。

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（11日）
item.description: 中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場安定化策を市場は注視している...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（11日） 11/11 18:37 配信

中国株式市場は小幅上昇する一方、香港株は下落した。世界的な金利上昇懸念の再燃と中国国内の市場安定化策を市場は注視している。

上海総合指数は序盤の下げから切り返し０．５％高で引けた。ＣＳＩ３００指数は０．４％上昇。

ハイテク株が上げを主導。深セン証券取引所の新興企業向け市場「創業板（チャイネクスト）」総合指数は３．１％、上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け市場「科創板」５０指数は２．８％それぞれ上昇した。

通信関連も上昇率の大きい業種の一つとなり、ＣＳＩ５Ｇ通信指数は６．７％高。光通信モジュールメーカーの中際旭創は１５％超急伸した。

香港市場のハンセン指数が１％安の２万４３１５．９２、ハンセンテック指数が１．４％安となった。

アジア域内の株式市場は、利上げ観測や原油市場動向にらみで動きづらく、狭いレンジでの取引となった。米国の消費者物価上昇率が予想を上回ったことや、政策当局者のタカ派姿勢を受け、利上げペースが加速するとの見方が強まった。

南華先物のアナリストはリポートで、これに伴う世界的な債券利回りの上昇とドル高が、中国Ａ株のバリュエーションを圧迫したと指摘。「足元の相場回復は主に、国内の市場支援策と海外の不確実性の一時的な緩和に支えられてきた。ただ、いずれの要因も効果の強さと持続性は限られるようだ。市場心理はやや改善したものの、投資家は総じて慎重姿勢を維持しており、株価指数は当面レンジ内で推移すると予想される」と述べた。

一方、原油価格は前営業日に２カ月ぶりの安値に下落した後、１１日は上昇した。イラン戦争の緊張緩和への期待と、ホルムズ海峡での船舶攻撃継続への懸念の間で市場は揺れ動いた。

ソウル株式市場は上昇して引けた。予想を上回る米インフレで追加利上げが懸念されたが、米コアウィーブの業績発表での見通しを受けてハイテク株が買われた。

半導体大手のサムスン電子は３．５７％、同業のＳＫハイニックスは５．３６％それぞれ上昇した。

米国の１０月の消費者物価は予想以上に上昇し、ＦＲＢが１２月に利上げするとの見通しが維持された。

取引された９１２銘柄のうち、５７５銘柄が上昇し、２９６銘柄が下落した。

海外投資家は６５７０億ウォン相当の買い越し。

シドニー株式市場は上昇し、約２カ月半ぶりの高値圏で引けた。鉱業株とハイテク株が上げを主導した。ただ、住宅ローン申込件数が減少したオーストラリア・コモンウェルス銀行（ＣＢＡ）株の下落が上値を抑えた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ／ＡＳＸ２００指数は０．３％高で終了。相対力指数（ＲＳＩ）は２日連続で７０近辺となり、買われ過ぎの状態を示した。

ベル・ダイレクトのシニアマーケットアナリスト、グレイディー・ウルフ氏は、大幅な調整というよりも、短期的な利益確定売りに「一段と脆弱になっている」と指摘。「一部の業種と主要な大型株がＲＳＩを押し上げている。ＢＨＰやリオ・ティント、大手銀行など、指数への影響が特に大きい銘柄が好調だ」と述べた。

米インフレ率が予想を上回り連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ観測が高まったが、影響は限定的だった。

米国とオーストラリアの１０年債利回り格差は２０２５年８月下旬以来の水準に縮小した。豪国債に対する米国債の利回りの上乗せ幅が縮小したことを示している。

金融株指数は０．４％下落。ナショナル・オーストラリア銀行は１．５％、ＣＢＡは１．２％それぞれ下落した。

ＣＢＡが発表した第１・四半期のキャッシュ利益は８％増加したが、住宅ローン申込件数は１６％減少した。高金利と新たな税制改革が需要を圧迫した。ウルフ氏は「利ざやの安定は好材料だが、住宅ローン需要の減速と延滞債権の増加は注意が必要だ」と述べた。

鉱業株指数は０．８％上昇。３営業日続伸し、１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ＢＨＰグループは０．９％、リオ・ティントは０．７％それぞれ上昇した。

ハイテク株指数は１．５％上昇し、終値で９月１日以来の高値となった。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連の混乱が続いた後、新たな買いが入った。

エネルギー株指数は０．７％、一般消費財株指数は０．５％それぞれ上昇した。

物価そのもの到達点とせず、好循環定着を＝諮問会議の民間議員 11/11 18:36 配信

item.title: 独景気回復、予想上回る 第4四半期に成長加速へ＝連銀総裁
item.description: [フランクフルト １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[フランクフルト １１日 ロイター] - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）のナーゲル総裁は１１日、ドイツの景気回復が予想より速く進んでおり、第４・四半期には成長が加速するとの見通しを示した。ただ根深い構造的な課題が引き続き成長の足かせになっているとした。

ラトビアの首都リガで開かれた会議で「われわれの中間的な評価は、夏時点の予想を上回る力強い回復を示している」と述べ、「第４・四半期には経済成長が加速する可能性が高い」とした。

独連銀は６月時点で、２０２６年の経済成長率を０．５％と予測していた。しかし現在は主要な予測機関の大半がその２倍を超える成長率を見込み、今後数年も成長が底堅く推移すると予想している。

ナーゲル氏は今年の大きな驚きは製造業、特に化学製品と電気機器の生産の回復だったと指摘し、受注水準を踏まえるとこの傾向は続く可能性が高いと述べた。

ただ「回復はまだ幅広い分野に及んでいない」と指摘し「個人消費は依然として低調で、第２・四半期には機械・設備投資が減少した」と述べた。

またドイツの潜在成長率は依然として極めて低く、引き上げるには抜本的な構造改革が必要との見解を示した。生産年齢人口が減少しているため労働市場改革が必要で、エネルギー部門の脱炭素化を進め、民間投資を一段と促す方策を見いださなければならないと述べた。

item.title: 台湾、ＡＰＥＣ首脳会議にエイサー創業者派遣へ 対等な参加要求
item.description:
Ben Blanchard
[台北 １１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ben Blanchard

[台北 １１日 ロイター] - 台湾は１１日、パソコンメーカー、エイサーの創業者、施振栄氏が、来週中国で開かれるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議に政府特使として出席すると発表した。台湾が対等な立場で参加できることを書面で保証するよう中国に求めた。

総統府の郭雅慧報道官は声明で、台湾はこれまでも全てのＡＰＥＣ会合に対等な立場で参加してきたと述べた。「これはＡＰＥＣの通常の慣行であり、いわゆる『一つの中国の原則』とは何の関係もない」とした。

ＡＰＥＣ参加国・地域は「全てのメンバーの対等な参加」で繰り返し合意してきたと指摘した。「台湾は中国が議長国としての責任を果たし、台湾代表団が平等、尊厳、安全が確保された条件の下で全ての会合に参加できるよう書面で保証することを望む」と述べた。

これに先立ち、中国の台湾事務弁公室の張ハン報道官は台湾のＡＰＥＣ参加について「一つの中国の原則とＡＰＥＣ覚書の規定および慣行に従って」対応していると表明した。「こうした慣行が守られる限り、（台湾は）会合に出席できる」と述べた。

台湾の労働相と財政相は今年、中国でのＡＰＥＣ会合に出席しており、問題は起きていない。

施氏は２００７年にオーストラリアで開かれたＡＰＥＣ首脳会議でも台湾の特使を務めた。

item.title: インタビュー：複数シナリオで財政議論必要、税収増は一時的ボーナス＝小黒法大教授
item.description:
Kentaro Sugiyama Makiko Yamazaki
［東京 １１日 ロイター］ - 法政大学経済学部の小...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インタビュー：複数シナリオで財政議論必要、税収増は一時的ボーナス＝小黒法大教授 11/11 18:18 配信

夕暮れの東京。2020年12月、東京で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Kentaro Sugiyama　Makiko Yamazaki

［東京　１１日　ロイター］ - 法政大学経済学部の小黒一正教授は１１日、ロイターとのインタビューで、物価上昇に伴う税収増などが当面は財政を下支えする一方、中長期的な財政の姿は金利や物価、名目成長率の動向によって大きく変わり得るため、複数の経済シナリオに基づく財政運営の議論が必要だと指摘した。

小黒氏は、名目経済成長率の拡大で税収が増える一方、公共事業費や診療報酬、介護報酬など歳出側への物価上昇の反映には時間差があるため、来年度予算については「思ったほど悪くならない形に着地する可能性がある」とみる。

小黒氏が一定の条件をもとに行った試算では、２０２７年度の一般会計歳出は、２０２６年度補正後の約１２５兆円から約１４１兆円に増加する。防衛費の増額、「強く豊かな日本」投資枠、飲食料品の消費税率引き下げに伴う地方消費税の減収補填、利払い費の増加などを見込んだ。

食料品減税を織り込むと、税収は約８４兆円、通常の税外収入は約８兆円となり、新規国債発行額は約４８兆円に達する。外為特会の剰余金や日銀が保有する上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）の売却益の活用を含め、追加の税外収入を８兆円程度確保できると仮定すれば、一般会計の新規国債発行額を４０兆円程度に抑えられる計算だ。

ただ、税収増が歳出増に先行することで生じる財政改善は「一時的なボーナス」であり、恒久的とは言いにくいという。歳出もいずれ物価を反映して増加するほか、日銀の利上げや国債の借り換えが進めば利払い費も膨らむ。

また、保有資産やその収益の活用によって一般会計の国債発行額を抑えても、それだけで政府・日銀を含む公的部門全体の財務状況が同じ額だけ改善するわけではないと指摘する。「個別政策にひも付いた財源論ではなく、基礎的財政収支や利払い費を含む財政収支、債務残高の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比が政策の実施前後でどう変化するのかを比較して評価すべきだ」とした。

小黒氏が金利、成長率、税収の伸びなどに一定の仮定を置いて行った中期試算では、名目成長率が３％で維持されれば、長期金利が３％から４％に上昇しても２０３６年度の普通国債残高の対ＧＤＰ比は足元からおおむね同水準にとどまったという。一方、長期金利が３％で、名目成長率が２％に下振れすれば、同指標が大きく悪化した。

小黒氏は、財政の将来像は金利や物価、成長率などの前提条件によって大きく変わると指摘。長期金利の上昇や成長率の下振れなど複数のケースを想定した情報を示しながら財政運営を議論していく必要があると強調した。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 焦点：消費減税、宙に浮く財源　成長投資・防衛費と「三重苦」の様相 コラム：消費減税と日銀の金融政策、求められる「物価の基調」の再定義＝井上哲也氏 コラム：財政拡張と円安は「日本売り」の予兆か＝内田稔氏 コラム：サナエノミクスが抱える物価高リスクを考える＝熊野英生氏 11/11(水) 18:18 最終更新 ロイター

Japan advisers urge focus on sustaining growth after inflation hits BOJ goal

TOKYO, Nov 11 : Private-sector members of the Japanese government's top economic panel said on Wednesday that hitting the central bank's 2 per cent inflation target is not an end in itself, stressing that higher incomes and productivity were needed for a lasting exit from deflation. The submission to the Council on Economic and Fiscal Policy, which is chaired by the prime minister and includes the finance minister and Bank of Japan governor, comes after the central bank last month declared victory in its nearly 14-year battle to achieve its inflation target. The four external experts on the council said that while there has been steady progress away from long-entrenched deflation, private consumption remains weak and improvements in real incomes and long-term growth expectations have yet to be fully realised. "What matters is not treating inflation itself as the end goal, but achieving a growth-driven economy with sustained increases in real incomes and productivity," they said.

The members also cited risks including energy prices, financial market conditions and trends in AI-related investment, urging policymakers to monitor developments and respond flexibly to maintain a stable macroeconomic environment. Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi struck a similar note in her closing remarks, saying the ultimate goal was to ensure people feel the benefits of economic growth through higher incomes and productivity. "Based on the existing joint accord, the government will continue to work closely with the BOJ, with each side fulfilling its respective role, to achieve price stability and sustainable economic growth," she added. The BOJ has flagged the need to continue raising interest rates to guard against upside price risks and prevent underlying inflation from overshooting its 2 per cent target. The core consumer price index rose an annual 2.1 per cent in September, exceeding the BOJ target for the first time in nine months. The government has stopped short of officially declaring victory over deflation, saying it needs clearer evidence that the economy will not slide back into a period of persistent price declines. "It's important for the government and the BOJ to closely coordinate and share views on economic and price conditions to secure price stability and sustainable economic growth," the private-sector members said in their submission.

Source: Reuters

FAST

Nov 11 : The dollar rose against most currencies on Wednesday, extending gains after inflation data and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials a day earlier fuelled bets that the US central bank will raise interest rates next month. The US dollar index, which measures the greenback's strength against a basket of six currencies, was 0.3 per cent higher at 102.53, hitting a four-week high. The gauge traded up 0.5 per cent on Tuesday after data showed US consumer prices increased by more than expected in October with costs higher for food and accommodations, marking a third consecutive month of upside surprises. "The dollar has continued to have some broad-based support on the expectation that the Fed would be more aggressive in their monetary tightening," said Rory Glass, an FX dealer at Marex in London.
